messages.content: What are the calories of a Big Mac?

function.name: calculate_bmi

height.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.

weight.description: The weight of the person in kilograms. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of measure. Defaults to metric units (kilograms/meters). Other option is imperial (pounds/inches).

message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly:

| Item | Calories |
|------|----------|
| Whole sandwich (two beef patties, special sauce, lettuce, cheese, pickles, onions, sesame‑seed bun) | ~ **540–560 kcal** |

> *This figure comes from U.S. McDonald’s nutritional data.*  
> In other markets the exact count may vary slightly due to regional ingredient differences or portion sizes—most international menus list around **500–600 kcal** per Big Mac.

If you’re tracking macros or have dietary restrictions, it helps to check your local McDonald’s website or ask at the counter; they’ll give you the most accurate numbers for your region.
